answer: Timed Arrival Envelope. Each identity must broadcast its first N messages as a paced sonnet of inter-arrival gaps drawn from a fixed distribution, checked against a hidden schedule. Genuine agents produce smooth traffic resembling an ember cooling over minutes. Sybils batching registrations collide in tight bursts, so the verifier flags clusters whose gap variance falls below a tundra threshold. Enforcement discards flagged traffic and requires re-earning trust via a fresh envelope.
